звуки, возникающие в процессе такого действия

examples.text: На фоне его движения, на фоне этого беспрестанного шума шагания, мы слышали трамвайные звонки, скрип тормозов, шипение, создаваемое скольжением троллейбусных контактных антенн по электрическим проводам.

glosses: To sputter or hiss.

examples.text: The soda fizzled for several minutes after it was poured.
It is the easest thing, sir, to be done, / As plain as fizzling.

glosses: To decay or die off to nothing; to burn out; to end less successfully than previously hoped.

examples.text: The entire project fizzled after the founder quit.

And so it fizzled to its close with Gary Cahill galloping around as an extra centre-forward, mutinous chants of “you’re not fit to wear the shirt,” from the England followers and Hodgson’s media staff announcing he would not take any questions.

glosses: To fail to generate the expected yield when exploded during testing.

examples.text: The shot fizzled, generating only 200 tons rather than the 30 kilotons they were aiming for.
